[]{#id1}

# Quickstart[¶](#quickstart "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

This page gives a brief introduction to the library and how to use it
with flow. It assumes you have the library installed, if you don't check
the [[Installing]{.std .std-ref}](intro.html#installing){.reference
.internal} portion of the intro page.

::: {.admonition .note}
Note

To get yourself familiar with flow, check out their
[guide](https://www.flowlauncher.com/docs/#/py-develop-plugins?id=about-flow39s-python-plugins){.reference
.external} for creating a plugin with the V1 API
:::

::::::::::::::::::::::::: {#setting-up-your-environment .section}
## Setting up your environment[¶](#setting-up-your-environment "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

See the [[manual installation instructions]{.std
.std-ref}](install_plugin.html#manual-install-instructions){.reference
.internal} for instructions on how to find where to create your plugin
folder.

Once you have your plugin folder in the right directory, you will need
to setup your environment. This guide will go over a simple but manual
way of setting up your environment. For a more automated method aimed at
more complex plugins, see the [[Writing Complex
Plugins]{.doc}](complex_plugins.html){.reference .internal} page.

:::::::: {#plugin-json .section}
[]{#pluginjson}

### plugin.json[¶](#plugin-json "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

In order for flow to actually register your plugin and know how to run
it, you will need a [`plugin.json`{.docutils .literal
.notranslate}]{.pre} file. [Json
Scheme](https://www.flowlauncher.com/schemas/plugin.schema.json){.reference
.external}

:::: {#keys .section}
#### Keys[¶](#keys "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

::: {.docutils .container}

[[ID]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: Your plugin's ID, a 32 bit UUID. Can be generated with
  [[`uuid.uuid4()`{.xref .py .py-func .docutils .literal
  .notranslate}]{.pre}](https://docs.python.org/3/library/uuid.html#uuid.uuid4 "(in Python v3.14)"){.reference
  .external}

<!-- -->

[[ActionKeyword]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: Your plugin's default action keyword ([`*`{.docutils .literal
  .notranslate}]{.pre} means no specific action keyword). This is only
  optional if [`ActionKeywords`{.docutils .literal .notranslate}]{.pre}
  is given.

<!-- -->

[[ActionKeywords]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: A list of keywords your plugin uses. This is optional.

<!-- -->

[[Name]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: The name of your plugin

<!-- -->

[[Description]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: A short description of your plugin

<!-- -->

[[Author]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: Your github username

<!-- -->

[[Version]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: The current version of your plugin (e.g. [`1.0.0`{.docutils .literal
  .notranslate}]{.pre}). It is important for automatic plugin updates.

<!-- -->

[[Language]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: The language your plugin is written in. In this case, it should be set
  to 'python_v2'

<!-- -->

[[Website]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: The plugin's website. If you don't have a website for it, use your
  plugin's github repository.

<!-- -->

[[IcoPath]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: The relative path to your plugin's icon

<!-- -->

[[ExecuteFileName]{.pre}]{.sig-name .descname}

: The python file that flow should execute to start your plugin. Ex:
  [`main.py`{.docutils .literal .notranslate}]{.pre}
:::
::::

::::: {#example .section}
#### Example[¶](#example "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

:::: {.highlight-json .notranslate}
::: highlight
    {
        "ID":"ed0770f8-5a99-493f-833a-93b34657a03a",
        "ActionKeyword":"*",
        "Name":"Example Plugin",
        "Description":"This is an example plugin to show how to use the plugin.json file",
        "Author":"cibere",
        "Version":"1.0.0",
        "Language":"python_v2",
        "Website":"https://github.com/cibere/Flow.Launcher.Plugin.ExamplePlugin",
        "IcoPath": "icon.png",
        "ExecuteFileName":"main.py",
    }
:::
::::
:::::
::::::::

::::: {#a-minimal-plugin .section}
### A Minimal Plugin[¶](#a-minimal-plugin "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

Let's make a plugin which compares how similar the user's query is with
the word [`Flow`{.docutils .literal .notranslate}]{.pre}. Since this is
the file that we call [[`flogin.plugin.Plugin.run()`{.xref .py .py-func
.docutils .literal
.notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.plugin.Plugin.run "flogin.plugin.Plugin.run"){.reference
.internal} in, this is the file that we should put as the
[`ExecuteFileName`{.docutils .literal .notranslate}]{.pre} key in our
[[plugin.json file]{.std .std-ref}](#pluginjson){.reference .internal}.

:::: {.highlight-python3 .notranslate}
::: highlight
     1from flogin import Plugin, Query
     2
     3plugin = Plugin()
     4
     5@plugin.search()
     6async def compare_results(data: Query):
     7    result = await plugin.api.fuzzy_search(data.text, "Flow")
     8    return f"Flow: {result.score}",
     9
    10plugin.run()
:::
::::

There's a lot going on here, so let's walk you through it line by line.

1.  The first line just imports the library, if this raises a
    [[`ModuleNotFoundError`{.xref .py .py-exc .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ModuleNotFoundError "(in Python v3.14)"){.reference
    .external} or [[`ImportError`{.xref .py .py-exc .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](https://docs.python.org/3/library/exceptions.html#ImportError "(in Python v3.14)"){.reference
    .external} then head on over to [[Installing]{.std
    .std-ref}](intro.html#installing){.reference .internal} section to
    properly install.

2.  Empty Line to increase readability

3.  Now we create an instance of [[`Plugin`{.xref .py .py-class
    .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.plugin.Plugin "flogin.plugin.Plugin"){.reference
    .internal}, which will let us work with Flow.

4.  Empty Line to increase readability

5.  Now, in line 5, we use the [[`search()`{.xref .py .py-func .docutils
    .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.plugin.Plugin.search "flogin.plugin.Plugin.search"){.reference
    .internal} decorator to create and register a
    [[`SearchHandler`{.xref .py .py-class .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.search_handler.SearchHandler "flogin.search_handler.SearchHandler"){.reference
    .internal} object using the function defined in line 6.

6.  Now in line 6, we define our handler's callback, which takes a
    single argument: [`data`{.docutils .literal .notranslate}]{.pre} of
    the type [[`Query`{.xref .py .py-class .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.query.Query "flogin.query.Query"){.reference
    .internal}

7.  In line 7, we access the [[`FlowLauncherAPI`{.xref .py .py-class
    .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.flow.api.FlowLauncherAPI "flogin.flow.api.FlowLauncherAPI"){.reference
    .internal} client, and use its [[`fuzzy_search()`{.xref .py .py-func
    .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.flow.api.FlowLauncherAPI.fuzzy_search "flogin.flow.api.FlowLauncherAPI.fuzzy_search"){.reference
    .internal} method to tell flow to use fuzzy search to compare the
    two strings inputted. In this case, we are telling Flow to compare
    whatever the user gave as their query. See [[`Query`{.xref .py
    .py-class .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.query.Query "flogin.query.Query"){.reference
    .internal} for more info on working with the query object.

8.  We are returning a string that contains our [`Flow`{.docutils
    .literal .notranslate}]{.pre} string and the results score. See the
    [[`FuzzySearchResult`{.xref .py .py-class .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.flow.fuzzy_search.FuzzySearchResult "flogin.flow.fuzzy_search.FuzzySearchResult"){.reference
    .internal} class for more information on using the result object.

9.  Empty Line to increase readability

10. Now we call plugin's [[`run`{.xref .py .py-class .docutils .literal
    .notranslate}]{.pre}](api.html#flogin.plugin.Plugin.run "flogin.plugin.Plugin.run"){.reference
    .internal} method to start the plugin.
:::::

::::::::: {#path-additions .section}
### Path Additions[¶](#path-additions "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

When flow runs your plugin, it won't detect your venv and run your
plugin through it. Because of this, you will have to add some code to
the top of the file you set as the execution file in order to add your
packages to path.

::: {.admonition .note}
Note

Make sure to add these to path before you do anything else.
:::

There are 3 main paths that you will want to add:

1.  The parent directory.

::: line
This is so that you can import other files in the same directory.
:::

2.  A [`lib`{.docutils .literal .notranslate}]{.pre} directory in the
    same folder as your file.

::: line
This is for when you end up publishing your plugin. Your published
plugin will have a copy of its dependencies in the [`lib`{.docutils
.literal .notranslate}]{.pre} dir.
:::

3.  Your venv's site packages directory.

::: line
This is for development, so you can install packages as normal into your
venv, and have them run just fine,
:::

:::: {.highlight-python3 .notranslate}
::: highlight
    import os
    import sys

    parent_folder_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(__file__)) # get the folder that your file is in
    sys.path.append(parent_folder_path) # add the folder to path
    sys.path.append(os.path.join(parent_folder_path, "lib")) # add a 'lib' folder that is in the same dir as your file to path
    sys.path.append(os.path.join(parent_folder_path, "venv", "lib", "site-packages")) # add your venv to path
:::
::::
:::::::::

:::::::: {#final-review .section}
### Final Review[¶](#final-review "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

To review, you should have a folder for your plugin in your flow plugins
folder, with the following files:

**plugin.json**

::: {.admonition .note}
Note

Ensure the [`ExecuteFileName`{.docutils .literal .notranslate}]{.pre}
key is set to [`main.py`{.docutils .literal .notranslate}]{.pre}
:::

:::: {.highlight-json .notranslate}
::: highlight
     1{
     2    "ID":"ed0770f8-5a99-493f-833a-93b34657a03a",
     3    "ActionKeyword":"*",
     4    "Name":"Example Plugin",
     5    "Description":"This is an example plugin to show how to use the plugin.json file",
     6    "Author":"cibere",
     7    "Version":"1.0.0",
     8    "Language":"python_v2",
     9    "Website":"https://github.com/cibere/Flow.Launcher.Plugin.ExamplePlugin",
    10    "IcoPath": "icon.png",
    11    "ExecuteFileName":"main.py",
    12}
:::
::::

**main.py**

:::: {.highlight-python3 .notranslate}
::: highlight
     1import os
     2import sys
     3
     4parent_folder_path = os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(__file__)) # get the folder that your file is in
     5sys.path.append(parent_folder_path) # add the folder to path
     6sys.path.append(os.path.join(parent_folder_path, "lib")) # add a 'lib' folder that is in the same dir as your file to path
     7sys.path.append(os.path.join(parent_folder_path, "venv", "lib", "site-packages")) # add your venv to path
     8
     9from flogin import Plugin, Query
    10
    11plugin = Plugin()
    12
    13@plugin.search()
    14async def compare_results(data: Query):
    15    result = await plugin.api.fuzzy_search(data.text, "Flow")
    16    return f"Flow: {result.score}",
    17
    18plugin.run()
:::
::::
::::::::
:::::::::::::::::::::::::

::: {#running-your-plugin .section}
## Running your plugin[¶](#running-your-plugin "Link to this heading"){.headerlink}

Now that our environment is setup, we can run and test our plugin. If
already put your plugin in the correct directory, great. If not, see the
[[manual installation instructions]{.std
.std-ref}](install_plugin.html#manual-install-instructions){.reference
.internal} and make sure that your plugin is in the right place.

After you have your plugin in the right place, which includes a properly
configured [[plugin.json]{.std .std-ref}](#pluginjson){.reference
.internal} file and your plugin file, all you have to do is restart
flow.
:::
